Posts.RecruitPostName: WXG - Data Scientist
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
WeiXin Group(WXG) is responsible for the construction and operation of the Weixin ecosystem and leveraging Weixin's open platforms such as Official Accounts, Mini Programs, Weixin Pay, WeCom and search function. WXG provides solutions and connectivity for intelligent upgrades across all industries. WXG is also responsible for the development and operation of QQ Mail, WeRead and other products.

What the Role Entails
Explore both qualitative and quantitative data sets, perform in-depth analysis to derive actionable insights, identify problems, and propose data-driven solutions for the WeChat ecosystem
Collect large sets of structured and unstructured data from independent sources; clean, validate, and transform data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and uniformity
Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and automated data pipelines to support ongoing business monitoring and decision-making
Analyze data to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies, uncovering potential opportunities and/or threats to the WeChat ecosystem
Interpret findings to discover solutions or opportunities and build story-boards to communicate insights to the business for action
Own and evolve the computer vision infrastructure, including building, optimizing, and maintaining CV model training/serving pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and related toolchains
Develop and deploy computer vision solutions (e.g., image/video understanding, OCR, content moderation, multimodal analysis) to address business needs across the WeChat ecosystem
Leverage LLM-based approaches and other machine learning / deep learning techniques where appropriate to enhance analytical capabilities and support intelligent product features

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a similar quantitative field
Hands-on experience with LLM application development (e.g., fine-tuning, RAG, Agent frameworks such as LangChain/LlamaIndex/AutoGen) is strongly preferred
Experience with computer vision models (e.g., object detection, image classification, multimodal models) is a plus
Good knowledge of Python; familiarity with C/C++ is a plus
Familiarity with mainstream deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model deployment tools (e.g., Docker, FastAPI, TensorRT) is preferred
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) or data pipeline tools is a plus
Ability to communicate complex technical ideas to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner
Self-driven, innovative, and collaborative, with strong communication and presentation skills; able to bridge business and technical audiences
Fluency in both English and Mandarin to collaborate with international stakeholders and headquarters-based teams

Posts.RecruitPostName: WXG - Senior Software Engineer - Infrastructure
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
WeiXin Group(WXG) is responsible for the construction and operation of the Weixin ecosystem and leveraging Weixin's open platforms such as Official Accounts, Mini Programs, Weixin Pay, WeCom and search function. WXG provides solutions and connectivity for intelligent upgrades across all industries. WXG is also responsible for the development and operation of QQ Mail, WeRead and other products.

What the Role Entails
WeChat is looking for Senior Software Engineers to build the infrastructure software and internal platforms behind services used by more than a billion users worldwide.

You will develop backend systems, platform capabilities, DevOps tooling, CI/CD frameworks, and automation that improve scalability, deployment efficiency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and production reliability. This is a software-engineering-first infrastructure role for candidates with strong coding ability and deep expertise in at least one of the following areas: distributed systems and microservices; databases, storage systems, and message queues; or AI infrastructure.Engineering Fundamentals Strong software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, system design, debugging, testing and code quality. Strong programming skills in at least one backend or systems language, preferably Go and/or C++.
Infrastructure and Platform Experience Demonstrated experience designing and building infrastructure software, internal platforms, developer tools or backend systems in production environments.
Specialisation — Deep Hands-On Expertise in at least one of: a) Distributed Systems and Microservices — service frameworks, orchestration, service discovery, dependency management, fault tolerance, or platform capabilities for microservice environments
b) Databases, Storage Systems and Message Queues — MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, distributed databases, object or block storage, Kafka, Pulsar, RabbitMQ, replication, failover, backup and recovery, or queue and streaming platform engineering
c) AI Infrastructure — model serving platforms, distributed training environments, inference systems, GPU or accelerator scheduling, AI workflow orchestration, high-throughput storage for AI workloads, or platform software for machine learning systems
Engineering Practices Experience with CI/CD systems, release automation, configuration management and safe production change practices. Experience building automation for operational efficiency, reliability improvement or infrastructure lifecycle management
Systems and Networking Strong understanding of Linux or Unix systems, backend runtime environments and systems-level debugging. Good understanding of networking fundamentals including HTTP, DNS, TLS and TCP/IP, and general client-server architecture.

Who We Look For
Education Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
Experience At least 6 years of experience in software engineering focused on infrastructure, backend platform engineering, or a closely related role supporting large-scale internet services.
Scale and Platform Depth Experience in infrastructure or platform engineering for hyperscale or globally distributed services. Strong experience with Kubernetes, containers and multi-cluster platform development or governance.
Platform and Developer Experience Experience building internal developer platforms, self-service infrastructure systems or infrastructure APIs. Experience with FaaS, event-driven platforms or internal compute orchestration systems.
Observability and Reliability Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, monitoring systems or production diagnostics tooling. Experience with disaster recovery architecture, resilience engineering, failover automation or business continuity tooling.
Engineering Excellence Experience improving platform engineering practices across design review, test strategy, release safety and operational excellence. Proven ability to mentor engineers and influence infrastructure engineering standards across teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience partnering across software, security, platform, data and AI teams to improve system architecture and reduce long-term operational burden.
Language Fluency in both English and Mandarin Chinese to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and headquarters-based teams
Problem Solving Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive complex technical problems from design through to production impact.

Posts.Responsibility:
部署紹介/Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS は、物語性の高いストーリー、没入感のあるゲームプレイ、最先端のテクノロジーを駆使し、ゲーム開発をアートとサイエンスの融合として追求し続けています。世界中のプレイヤー、そしてあらゆるデバイスに次世代のゲームエクスペリエンスを提供することを使命としています。
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
Job Description
- Game Feature Development: Participate in the design, development, and debugging of game client modules, implementing gameplay systems and interaction logic
- Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize client-side performance, addressing issues related to frame rate, memory usage, and loading times
- Game AI: Contribute to the design and implementation of AI behaviors for NPCs, enemies, and bosses, including behavior trees and state machines
- AI Harness Engineering: Build and iterate on the supporting framework for AI agents in games, including prompt design, tool calling, context management, evaluation pipelines, and the integration of LLMs / agents with the game runtime

応募資格/Who We Look For
Requirements
- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or a related field (Junior year and above for undergraduates / Master's students)
- Proficient in C++
- Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine or Unity
- English: Strong reading and writing skills
- Japanese: JLPT N1 or equivalent proficiency
- Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming
- Genuine passion for game development; an active gamer
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
Nice to Have
- Personal or team-based game development projects (Demos / Game Jams / portfolio works)
- Understanding of network synchronization, physics engines, and related systems
- Experience in AI Harness / Agent framework development (e.g., prompt engineering, tool calling, agent pipeline design, LLM application evaluation)
- Familiarity with reinforcement learning fundamentals (e.g., PPO, DQN, and other common algorithms)
- Familiarity with mainstream LLM APIs or agent development frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen)
- Knowledge of game AI techniques (behavior trees, GOAP, pathfinding algorithms, etc.)
- An active GitHub profile, technical blog, or game portfolio
- Experience with version control tools such as Git or Perforce
